answer: Each agent binds its identity to a hardware enclave key whose lattice signature anchors a per-epoch atlas of attested public keys, so a sybil must forge attestations rather than spawn keys. Peers trace every thread of consensus messages back to that atlas and weight votes by enclave-attested stake, while a sable reputation ledger records misbehavior across epochs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
